verdict.rationale: Docusign's CLM and AI-Assisted Review products explicitly support drafting, redlining, and reviewing agreements against playbooks with suggested edits and MS Word integration, replacing ad hoc email-based negotiation (docusign-docs-16, docusign-docs-20, docusign-docs-25, docusign-docs-28, docusign-docs-41, docusign-docs-44). However, all evidence is first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on corroboration that the redline/negotiation workflow works as described, and community evidence in the pack focuses on e-signature API integration pain points and phishing, not on the negotiation/redlining experience. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the redlining workflow, detail on version control/audit trail during negotiation, and confirmation that email attachments are fully displaced in real deployments.
